Noaptea Lupilor

Noaptea Lupilor: An Andrzejki Celebration at Home

Step into the enchanting world of Andrzejki, a Polish tradition of fortune-telling and merriment, right from the comfort of your home. This special night, once for young women seeking future spouses, is now a joyful occasion for all to share playful prophecies and delicious treats.

  1. Late Afternoon

    Setting the Scene

    Begin your Andrzejki preparations by gathering keys and candles. Start preparing traditional treats to set a festive mood for the evening's magic.

    Recipes: Romanian Poppy Seed Roll (Cozonac cu Mac) · Traditional Romanian Honey Cookies · Pickled Herring

  2. Early Evening

    A Feast of Fortune

    Gather your loved ones to enjoy a delightful spread of traditional Polish fare, fueling up for a night of prophecies and fun.

    Recipes: Romanian Poppy Seed Roll (Cozonac cu Mac) · Traditional Romanian Honey Cookies · Pickled Herring · Traditional Romanian Mead (Mied) · Herb Infused Tea for Noaptea Lupilor

  3. Evening

    Wax Divination

    Carefully pour hot wax through the keyhole of an old key into a bowl of cold water, watching as unique shapes form, hinting at your future.

  4. Late Evening

    Shadow Play & Prophecies

    Hold your cooled wax creations up to a candle flame and observe the mysterious shadows they cast, interpreting their playful messages about what's to come.

  5. Night

    Merriment & Mead

    Share your interpretations and enjoy warm cups of mead or herb-infused tea, savoring the cozy atmosphere and good company.

    Recipes: Traditional Romanian Mead (Mied) · Herb Infused Tea for Noaptea Lupilor

  6. Deep Night

    Dance Until Dawn

    Put on some lively music and dance the night away, embracing the joyful spirit and ancient traditions of Andrzejki.

  7. Just Before Dawn

    Reflecting on Futures

    As the night winds down, share any final playful prophecies and enjoy the lingering magic, looking forward to the year ahead.

May your Noaptea Lupilor be filled with warmth, wonder, and delightful glimpses into your future!
